channel.title: Robusta Coffee Monitor
channel.description: Daily model-driven read on coffee markets and Vietnamese Central Highlands growing conditions.

item.title: Coffee monitor — 2026-09-18 — crisis
item.description: Coffee futures closed at 277¢/lb — down 11.6% on the week and down 22.9% on the month. The regime model reads the market as crisis and has for 1 sessions. Rainfall in the Central Highlands is running above its seasonal norm (+1.6σ) — favorable moisture for the robusta belt. The crop is in its fruit filling window, and stage-weighted stress is low. The Brazilian real is little changed on the month (-0.7%) — a neutral currency backdrop.
